«آتے ہی» could be read as 'as soon as the train comes'. Now «اور اسٹیشن پہنچتے ہی …», the reader's own wording. The place is the station the sentence already names and the operator's 'departure station', so no fact is added; 'on arrival' is kept, as are 'at least', 'one hour' and 'before departure'. The repeated «پہنچ» root is accepted as the price of an unambiguous referent.

«ریل گاڑی» is the published page's word for the train (heading, body, FAQ, tm pairs of this page); the new paragraph must say it the same way. «ٹرین» is not a termbase entry under P16. The page title is published text, out of scope.

source_defects: Reader 3: neither source says which payment cards (e.g. foreign debit/credit cards) are accepted for online train tickets; published text, logged only.

R6: «سابتکو» unexplained at its first mention in the section.

R9: «پہیوں والی کرسی» heard as translated (reader's «وہیل چیئر», a P16 question); «اوبر» twice in one sentence.
R11: page title «نقل و حمل اور آمد و رفت» heard as a bookish, redundant pair.
notes: Fact fence re-checked on the final paragraph: inside the station OR when boarding; «کم از کم» (at least); «ایک گھنٹہ» (one hour, in words by N104); «روانگی سے … پہلے» (before departure); «سعودی ریلوے کمپنی کے کسی ملازم کو اطلاع دیں» (tell a member of the operator's staff); «اسٹیشن پہنچتے ہی» (on arrival).
